lead.headline: ROBOTAXI SNITCHES ON JUVENILES ARMED WITH ILLEGAL GHOST GUN!
lead.summary: A driverless Waymo cab turned informant in San Francisco, alerting local police to passengers carrying a loaded, illegal AR-style ghost gun. Officers conducted a high-risk vehicle stop on the autonomous cruiser and arrested two juvenile riders. This dramatic bust highlights the growing surveillance capabilities of robotaxis patrolling city streets.

stories.headline: HYUNDAI TARGETS TESLA WITH NEW ARTRIA AI SYSTEM
stories.summary: South Korean auto giant Hyundai is gearing up to challenge Tesla's self-driving dominance. The firm announced plans to launch its proprietary "Artria AI" autonomous system by 2029, relying on continuous data training to conquer edge-case driving scenarios.

stories.headline: CYBERCABS SPOTTED WITH STEERING WHEELS IN AUSTIN
stories.summary: Tesla’s promise of a fully autonomous future hit a bump as reports reveal many Cybercabs still sport traditional steering wheels. With only 45 cramped vehicles currently operating in Austin, the electric vehicle pioneer faces a steep climb to realize its grand robotaxi vision.

stories.headline: TESLA TEASES LONG-DELAYED ROADSTER REVEAL FOR OCTOBER
stories.summary: Nearly a decade after its first prototype debut, Tesla is teasing an October 1 reveal for its next-generation Roadster. A dramatic "Go for launch" teaser image has reignited excitement, though production timelines and pricing remain shrouded in mystery.

stories.headline: MIT TEACHES ROBOT CARS TO EXPLAIN THEMSELVES
stories.summary: Brilliant minds at MIT have developed a novel program that allows autonomous vehicles to explain their decisions to human passengers. By telling riders exactly what they see and why they are acting, researchers hope to build trust between man and machine.

stories.headline: APPLE SHELVES PLANS FOR COVETED ELECTRIC CAR
stories.summary: The tech titan in Cupertino has hit the brakes on its highly anticipated electric vehicle project. Apple has officially postponed the launch of its electric car, marking a quiet retreat from the brutal automotive arena.

lead.headline: ALTMAN FORESEES NOBEL PEACE PRIZE FOR TRUMP-XI AI TREATY!
lead.summary: OpenAI chieftain Sam Altman turned heads by suggesting Donald Trump and Xi Jinping could clinch a Nobel Peace Prize. Altman envisions a historic US-China AI safety treaty that would set global standards and cool geopolitical tensions. Critics and watchdogs are closely monitoring this bold diplomatic prediction as the race for AI supremacy heats up.

stories.headline: ANTHROPIC PLEDGES HALF-TRILLION DOLLARS FOR CLOUD COMPUTE
stories.summary: AI startup Anthropic is betting the farm on infrastructure with a staggering $517 billion commitment for cloud and compute deals over the next decade. The massive war chest signals a ferocious battle ahead with tech giants for hardware and processing power.

stories.headline: OPENAI DROPS SPONSORSHIP OF CALTECH MATH COMPETITION
stories.summary: A bitter feud has erupted between OpenAI and the academic community after the AI firm yanked its support for the Caltech Mathathon. While mathematicians decry the move as destructive, OpenAI representatives defended the decision, calling it a strategic disruption.

stories.headline: DEEPMIND SAFETY EXPERT RESIGNS OVER SUPERINTELLIGENCE DANGERS
stories.summary: Top researcher Josh Engels has walked away from Google's DeepMind, warning that the stakes of advanced AI are simply too high. Engels turned down lucrative offers from rival firms to sound the alarm on the rapid, unchecked rise of superintelligent machines.

stories.headline: SAM ALTMAN SETS SIGHTS ON AMERICAN POWER GRID
stories.summary: Fresh off high-profile tech collaborations, OpenAI boss Sam Altman is now making moves to secure a foothold in the US electrical grid. The aggressive expansion highlights the insatiable energy appetite of next-generation artificial intelligence models.

stories.headline: PRESIDENT XI PLEDGES BRICS OPEN-SOURCE AI COOPERATION
stories.summary: Speaking at the New Delhi summit, Chinese President Xi Jinping announced plans for China to lead a new open-source AI community for developing nations. The move aims to foster tech collaboration among BRICS countries and challenge Western dominance in the field.

stories.headline: SENIOR-ASSISTING HOME ROBOT STIRS PRIVACY CONCERNS
stories.summary: A new rolling domestic robot designed by Tuya Smart promises to help elderly citizens by alerting family members during emergencies. However, the high-tech companion is drawing scrutiny from privacy advocates as key questions about data security remain unanswered.
